passages.note: Final Senate vote on SB1457; the bill's content does not set a general gestational-stage rule the ladder differs on.
Bill history lists Petersen as co-sponsor of SB1457, which does not address the ladder's gestational-stage dimension.

passages.provision_quote: A facility that is run by or that operates on the property of a public educational institution may not Perform or provide an abortion, unless the abortion is necessary to save the life of the woman having the abortion.
passages.note: Operative clauses ban sex/race/genetic-abnormality-selective abortion and restrict abortion at public-school facilities; neither sets a general stage-of-pregnancy rule.

rows.reasoning: SB 1457 (2021), which Petersen co-sponsored and voted Yea on at Final Reading, bans abortions sought because of the child's sex, race, or a genetic abnormality, adds informed-consent and clinic regulations, and bars abortion at public-educational-institution facilities except to save the mother's life. None of this establishes a general rule for when abortion is legal or banned across the stages of pregnancy, which is the question the five rungs differ on, so no passage is on-question.
